sub_palette: celtic (goidelic) backbone + east_asian (sinitic) overlay (cross-family blend, Celtic-leaning)

blend.backbone: celtic (goidelic / Gaelic register: ri/tuath, the Mac-/O- patronymics, lenition c>ch and b>bh/v, broad-slender consonants, the cland and fine kin-groups, the dun/rath hill-forts, the warrior-clans of cattle and the sword)
blend.overlay: east_asian (sinitic: the -cheng silk-cities, the -jiang rivers and -shan mountains, the Confucian -di/-wang/-jun mandarin bureaucracy, monosyllabic surname-first names, the contour-toned isolating substrate, the silk-and-river populace)
blend.lean: Celtic-heavy - a Goidelic warrior-clan aristocracy that came to the legendary eastern land of Fusang and set itself up as ri-kings over a Sinitic silk-and-river civilization: the Gaelic flaith and his cland-kin hold the dun above the river-mouth, the Chinese mandarins, the cheng-cities and the silk-and-river populace endure and serve beneath.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_02 (Celtic, Goidelic) x BASE_09 Jinxia (Sinitic/Chinese). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Celtic base = Clanhold, Sinitic (Jinxian/Chinese) base = Civilized, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Fusangwyn is Civilized (feudal). Concept: a Goidelic warrior-clan aristocracy that sailed to the legendary eastern land of Fusang at the edge of the world and set itself up as ri-kings over the Sinitic silk-and-river empire and its Mandate court - Celtic war-clans fused with a silk-and-river civilization. Backbone = Celtic (GOIDELIC: the warrior-clan ruling layer, the ri/flaith register, Mac-/O- patronymics, the cland/fine kin-groups, the dun/rath forts); overlay/substrate = Sinitic (the -cheng silk-cities, the -jiang/-shan land, the Confucian mandarin bureaucracy, the silk-and-river populace, the monosyllabic surname-first names). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Gaelic and Chinese registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Celtic Goidelic reflexes PRIMARY from family_celtic theonym_set; Sinitic variants SECONDARY from family_east_asian theonym_sets.sinitic, in the jinxian -di/-jun register), never real Celtic/Chinese gods. No approved foreign term applies (no Chinese term is on the approved list), so ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are ENGLISH; the conlang forms live in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. Register choice: Celtic-base hybrids default to the GOIDELIC reflexes (ri, tuath, flaith, cland), the Brythonic sub-palette held in reserve - flag for Jedidiah if a Brythonic register is wanted instead. All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic. Deities are the canonical Agrippan pantheon via the per-family morph method.

phonology.palette: Celtic (Goidelic) backbone - initial consonant mutation (lenition c>ch, b>bh/v, m>mh/v, t>th, d>dh; nasalization), broad vs slender consonants, vowels a e i o u (long marks dropped in data), root-initial stress, Mac-/O- patronymics, -an/-in diminutives - meeting a Sinitic overlay: monosyllabic morphemes, syllable (C)(G)V(C) with only -n/-ng codas, contour tones (unmarked in data), NO native consonant clusters, surname(1)+given(1-2), the celestial -di/-jun/-wang titles. Per the CSV: an analytic flow with lyrical vowels - the lenited Gaelic consonants softening into the open Sinitic monosyllable, the tonal contour carried over the broad-slender lilt; grammar shifts toward SVO and isolating (the Sinitic substrate) with the Celtic mutations retained on the leading consonant - 'SVO, isolating grammar with mutations'. Theophoric on the Goidelic reflexes (Toran-, Orlann-) with Sinitic -di/-jun variants (Tuli-di, Aolan-jun).
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC; Gaelic mutation-driven clusters and the broad-slender contrast meeting the tight Sinitic monosyllable (no clusters, only -n/-ng codas) - the river-port names fuse a Goidelic element with a -cheng/-jiang Sinitic head; root-initial Celtic stress laid under the Sinitic tonal contour; Mac-/O- clan-names over surname-first Sinitic mandarin names.

sound_changes: Sinitic contour-tones dropped entirely; pitch becomes Goidelic root-initial stress (the lilt carries the old contour)
Sinitic isolating monosyllables are compounded into Goidelic disyllabic shapes: a bare CV root takes a Gaelic vocalic tail or -an/-ach extension; -n/-ng codas broaden to Goidelic -nn/-nng
Goidelic initial mutation applies to the leading consonant of any root: c>ch, b>bh, m>mh, t>th, d>dh, s softens; broad-vs-slender vowel-harmony reshapes the syllable
Sinitic initials with no Goidelic match are naturalized: zh/ch/q/j>s or sh, x>s, no native clusters so any Sinitic cluster is broken to CV-CV
every root, from either parent, is then forced to one Goidelic phonology - root-initial stress, broad-slender harmony, the fada-less ASCII vowels a e i o u
fusion_rules.source_tilt: river/land/silk/material/civic words from Sinitic roots (the silk-and-river substrate works the land, trades the silk, runs the cheng): river/mountain/forest, the city/market/port, silk/jade/cattle, the -cheng head; kin-line/quality/abstract/rule/war words from Goidelic roots (the ruling warrior-clan register): son/daughter/kin, great/old/sacred, the dun/rath fort; every chosen root is then filtered to the one Goidelic sound-law

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Sinitic river/silk/material/civic-roots + Goidelic rule/kin-roots, all run through one Goidelic-shaped sound-law (tones dropped into root-initial stress, isolating monosyllables compounded into Gaelic disyllables, lenition and broad-slender on every leading consonant); portmanteaus mark the blended bloodline and the shared institutions.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Goidelic ruling stock keep the Mac- (son of) / O-/Ua- (descendant of) patronymic and a cland (wider clan) / fine (kin-group) name; the Sinitic populace keep the clan-surname (xing) first, then the given name (ming), with generation-names within a zu; the throne fuses both - a flaith who carries both an O- lineage and a granted xing of the Mandate-court.
morphology.compounding_rule: Goidelic [quality|feature|saint](stem) + element (Dun-derg, red-fort; Ard-mor, great-height) fused to Sinitic quality+type heads (Jin-cheng, golden-city; Da-jiang, great-river): the capital Dun-Fusang (the fort of Fusang), Iarann-cheng (the iron-walled city), Si-abha (the silk-river).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Goidelic warrior-clan aristocracy over the Sinitic silk-empire: the ard-ri and his cland-kin at the Mandate-throne, the flaith and ri-tuaithe over the river-cheng, the cland-sworn caur-champions of the war-band; the Sinitic mandarinate - the wang, the five peerages and the Confucian officials - serve beneath and run the cheng-cities and the silk-revenues)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Goidelic clanhold ladder raised to a feudal civ, ascending, with the Sinitic mandarin co-titles beneath. Toisech (clan-chief, leader) barony over a Toiseacht (chiefry); Ri-criche (border-king, march-king) march over a Crioch (border-territory); Flaith (lord, noble) county over a Flaithes (lordship); Mor-flaith (great-lord) duchy over a Mor-thuath (great tuath); Ri-tuaithe (king of a tuath, petty-king) principality over a Tuath (petty kingdom); Ruiri (over-king) kingdom over a Ruirecht; Ard-ri (high-king, the one who holds the Mandate-throne) empire over the Ard-riocht (the high-kingdom). The conquered silk-empire keeps its Sinitic Wang (king-of-the-old-line, now a vassal-prince) and the five peerages Gong > Hou > Bo > Nan beneath the Gaelic crown, plus the Dudu frontier-commanders and the Confucian officials who run the cheng-cities. The brithem (judge) and the fili/ollam (poet-sage), and the Sinitic Daoshi, stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Gaelic and Chinese registers (allowed).
title_ladder.heir: Ri-damna (the king's heir-apparent, the throne-worthy; the Sinitic court calls him Taizi, the crown-prince)

honorifics.elder: Sinsear (the elder) / the Bixia at the Mandate-throne

vassalage.fealty: Mionn (the sworn oath) / Mengyue (Sinitic sworn covenant)

title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Goidelic ruling stock carry a personal name + Mac-/O- patronymic and a cland/fine lineage; the Sinitic populace carry a monosyllabic surname (xing) first, then the given name (ming); order given-first for the Goidelic, surname-first for the Sinitic.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Goidelic warrior-clan aristocracy keep Gaelic names (Conn-, Bran-, Aed-, Niall-, -an/-ach) with Mac-/O- patronymics; the Sinitic city-folk and mandarins keep the xing + ming names (Li Zhongyan, Wang Yurong) and the official courtesy-name (zi).
people_name_convention.theophoric: Goidelic devotional on the morphed canon-reflexes (the Toran- and Orlann- elements): Mael-Toran (devotee/tonsured-of-Toran), Gilla-Orlann (servant of Orlann); the Sinitic substrate invokes the celestial powers' epithets rather than the god-name directly - Tian-en (heaven's grace), or a temple-name honoring Tuli-di.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Celtic Goidelic reflexes PRIMARY (family_celtic theonym_set), Sinitic variants SECONDARY (family_east_asian theonym_sets.sinitic, rendered in the jinxian -di/-jun celestial register), never real Celtic/Chinese gods. The Goidelic warrior-clans keep their sword-and-oath powers honored at the nemed-grove; the conquered silk-empire keeps its Celestial Bureaucracy under the Mandate of Heaven, and the two are quietly identified (one power, two faces). All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic: Lawful reads the just Mandate-throne and the sworn cland-oath, Neutral reads the older clan ancestral war-dead and the local earth-and-grain powers.
religion.the_one: Eternan (Celtic; Sinitic Aiteng) - the distant Ancient One, the Highest Heaven, honored not petitioned

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Toran (Sinitic Tuli-di) - the sun and justice, the Sun-Justice Emperor
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gaian (Sinitic Gaidun-di) - the enduring earth, lord of mountains
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Realtan (Sinitic Lianta-mu) - the mother, mercy, the Mother of Mercy

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Eternan foremost, Toran the just, Orlann of the sworn war, Realtan the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers as the fuath (Goidelic spectres/foes) or the Sinitic mo (demon-marshals), warded and unworshipped; the cland-oath, the just ri and the Mandate-throne are the social ideal
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead (the Goidelic cland-forebears and the deified ri) and the Sinitic ancestors (the zu) and local earth-and-grain powers; the great powers invoked at the nemed (sacred grove) and the miao situationally rather than worshipped wholesale
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Eternan - as the tyrant-gods to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as fuath (Goidelic spectres) or mo (Sinitic demon-marshals), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maragan the War-Brand (Sinitic Maluo the War-Fire Marshal); Vacidus -> Faicid the Unmaker (Sinitic Wuci the Devourer); Lusanto -> Losand the Hoard-Worm (Sinitic Lusan the Coin-Serpent).
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemed (Goidelic sacred grove) or Cill (church/cell), or the Miao (Sinitic temple) of [power]: 'the Nemed of Toran', 'the Miao of Tuli-di'; the ancestral Ci (Sinitic clan-shrine) for the zu.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified war-dead and ri of the Goidelic cland, honored at the nemed-grove and the cill; and the worthy officials and heroes of the silk-empire enrolled in the celestial register, honored at the Ci (ancestral shrine) and the Miao.

holy_symbol_motifs.Gaian: the green mountain over the grain-altar
